sources.entry: VibeKit - Mobile-first AI app builder where each app gets its own persistent coding agent that builds it, hosts it on a live domain and keeps improving it, from an iPhone or the web. #freemium

summary.name: VibeKit
summary.one_liner: VibeKit is a mobile-first AI app builder where each app gets its own persistent AI agent that builds, hosts, monitors, and improves it on a live URL.
use_cases: Build a small web app or tool by describing it from a phone
Deploy and host a side project on a live URL
Create a landing page with a waitlist
Build a full-stack app with login and a database
Deploy apps from Claude Code, Cursor or other MCP clients
Automatically monitor and redeploy a crashing app
summary.what_it_does: VibeKit lets you describe an app in plain language from an iPhone, the web, CLI, or API, and an AI agent builds and deploys it to a vibekit.bot subdomain. Each app gets a persistent agent with memory of the codebase, which runs health checks every 60 seconds and, per the page, diagnoses crashes, applies fixes, and redeploys. Users can choose Claude, GPT, Gemini, Grok or DeepSeek per app, using their own Anthropic or OpenAI key (BYOK) or VibeKit credits. An MCP server lets external agents such as Claude Code, Cursor or Codex deploy apps, add databases, set env vars and read logs. The page also mentions managed OAuth connections to services like Gmail, Slack, Notion and Stripe, and web search that is paid from credits.
notable: Each app gets its own persistent AI agent with memory that monitors, heals and improves it
BYOK: use your own Anthropic or OpenAI key so you pay the provider directly rather than buying bundled AI credits
MCP server lets Claude Code, Cursor, Codex and other MCP clients deploy and manage apps on VibeKit
Managed hosting with live URLs, auto-redeploy on git push, and optional custom domains
caveats: Free tier is limited to 10 AI sessions per month and 2 workspaces, with auto-sleep on the free app
Paid Builder and Pro plans are subscriptions ($20/mo and $25/mo of AI credit per the page); Builder's always-on and custom domain features require the paid tier
Page describes the product as early and asks for feedback; features may change
Prices for Builder and Pro show as 'Loading price…' in the page text, so current pricing should be checked on the site
